answer: The registry accepts a npm package maintainer link only through a fresh-nonce signature. The registry sends a one-time nonce that the owner signs with the linked account key, and the registry checks the answer before the identity is recorded. The dune that seals the link is the verified response; a anchor of doubt reopens the check, and a copper of failed answers bars the claim, so an agent cannot register a npm package maintainer belonging to someone else.
